question: How is the Lord of Serpents honored as ruler of the three worlds?
premises: Obeisance is offered to the lord of the three worlds.
The same deity is addressed as Lord of Serpents.
The salutation is repeated for reverence.
inference: Nāgeśa is revered as the lord of the three worlds.
plain_english: Obeisance to the lord of the three worlds, obeisance, obeisance to Nāgeśa.
